Refreshed 21 Nov 2026 from the same Google/YouTube India suggestions and top YouTube results. Refreshed 28 Nov 2026 from the same Google/YouTube India suggestions.
rules: Lead with the exact phrase people search (from this file), word for word, in the first line of every caption, in the YouTube title, and in the reel's first on-screen text. Never use a phrase the post doesn't answer.
YouTube Shorts title: exact search phrase first, then the topic, then '| TenderTez'; under 70 characters so it isn't cut on phones.

Reel caption (shared by YouTube, Instagram and Facebook): line 1 answers the search phrase in Hinglish; line 2 repeats it in Hindi (Devanagari) from 'hindi_phrases' for people who search in Hindi; then the guide link with UTM (utm_source=youtube); 'Voice-over AI se banaya gaya hai.'; then exactly 5 hashtags in this order: 2 topic, 1 audience, #tendertez, #shorts (YouTube shows the first 3 above the title; Instagram's 3-5 limit is met).
YouTube tags: 8-12 from the topic's keywords plus 'government tender', 'gem portal', 'tendertez'.
Instagram image posts: 3-5 niche hashtags (2 topic + 1 audience + #tendertez, optionally 1 broad). No generic tags (#business, #india, #viral).
Instagram image posts: alt text that contains the search phrase.
Reels also go to the Facebook page as a REEL (facebookData type REEL, title = YouTube title).
Facebook: 2-3 hashtags; the link carries UTM.
X: at most 1-2 hashtags; the search phrase in the first line; link carries UTM.
Every link to tendertez.in carries ?utm_source=<instagram|youtube|facebook|x>&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=<topic slug>, so the nightly numbers show which channel and topic bring visitors.
Pick the audience tag that matches who the post helps: see 'audience_by_topic'.

Posting times (Metricool best-time data for this account, IST): Instagram peaks 10:00 then 18:00; YouTube peaks 16:00 then 10:00. Reels (IG + YT + FB) at 10:30 and 17:00; Instagram/Facebook image posts at 10:00/10:15; stories 09:30; X 09:30, 13:00, 17:00.
Never use unrelated trending tags; every tag must match the post's topic.
